hook.name: AtlasHook
hook.description: On-chain smart order router hook that intercepts every swap and reroutes it across up to six embedded Uniswap v3 and v4 pools for best execution. It computes an optimal route via an on-chain RFQ, executes nested swaps, collects a service fee via donate(), and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to replace the native pool's swap. Liquidity addition and pool initialization are restricted to the contract admin.
